bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; requiring charter schools and charter school authorizers to publish financial information; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, sections 124E.03, by adding a subdivision; 124E.16, by adding subdivisions.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124E.03, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 11.

Publication of financial information.

A charter school must comply with section 123B.10, subdivision 1, governing publishing of school budgets.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124E.16, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 2a.

Publication of financial information; charter school; authorizer.

A charter school must submit its annual budget to the commissioner consistent with section 123B.10, subdivision 1.

Sec. 3.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124E.16, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 2b.

Tax filings.

A charter school and an authorizer must publish annual state and federal tax filings on their respective public websites.
